# NoSleep

> A calm, private digital space to keep your screen awake, focus with ambient soundscapes, and explore interactive visuals.

NoSleep (https://nosleeppage.com) is an open web utility using the W3C Screen Wake Lock API and Web Audio API procedural synthesis. It runs 100% in the browser with zero accounts, zero software downloads, and zero telemetry.

## Core Pages
- [NoSleep Web Tool](https://nosleeppage.com/): Primary screen wake lock engine, focus timer, and ambient space.
- [Keep Screen On Online](https://nosleeppage.com/keep-screen-on/): Prevent display sleep on Windows, Mac, iPad, and Android without downloads or admin rights.
- [No Screen Off](https://nosleeppage.com/no-screen-off/): Free browser display awake utility for work, study, reading, and presentations.
- [Rain Ambient Soundscape](https://nosleeppage.com/sounds/rain/): High-fidelity procedural rainfall generator for deep study and sleep.
- [Ocean Waves Soundscape](https://nosleeppage.com/sounds/ocean/): Deep relaxing ocean surf generator.
- [Brown Noise Generator](https://nosleeppage.com/sounds/brown-noise/): Low-frequency acoustic masking sound.
- [Pomodoro Focus Timer](https://nosleeppage.com/focus/pomodoro/): 25-minute focus intervals with ambient audio.
- [Breathing Relaxation](https://nosleeppage.com/relax/breathing/): 4-7-8 breathing circle generative art.
- [About NoSleep](https://nosleeppage.com/about/): Project vision, architecture, and technology stack.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nosleeppage.com/privacy/): 100% client-side privacy specification.
- [Terms of Service](https://nosleeppage.com/terms/): Terms of service.
- [Audio Licensing Credits](https://nosleeppage.com/audio-credits/): Procedural synthesis and licensing credits.

## Optional
- [Full Technical Specification](https://nosleeppage.com/llms-full.txt): Complete architecture, browser API implementations, and audio synthesis details.
